लता [लत्-अच्]
1 A creeper,
creeping plant; लताभावेन परिणतमस्या
रूपं

. Often used as the last member
of compounds, especially with words
meaning ‘arm’, ‘eyebrow’,
‘lightning’, to denote beauty, tenderness,
thinness &c.; भुजलता, बाहुलता, भ्रूलता,
विद्युल्लता; so खड्ग˚, अलक˚, &c.; cf.

.
--2 A branch.
--3 The creeper
called Priyaṅgu.
--4 The Mādhavī
creeper.
--5 Musk-creeper.
--6 A whip
or the lash of a whip.
--7 A string
of pearls.
--8 A slender woman.
--9
A woman in general.
--10 The Dūrvā
grass.
--Comp.
--अंगुलिः f. a branch
serving as a finger.
--अंतं a
flower.
--अंबुजं a kind of cucumber.
--अर्कः a green onion.
--अलकः an
elephant.
--आननः a particular
position of the hands in dancing.
[]
--उद्गमः the upward winding or climbing
of a creeper.
--करः a particular
position of the hands in dancing.
--कस्तूरिका, कस्तूरी musk-creeper.
--गृहःहं a bower surrounded with
creepers, an arbour;

.
--जिह्वः,
--रसनः a snake.
--तरुः {1} the Sāla
tree. {2} the Tāla tree. {3} the orange
tree.
--पनसः the water-melon.
--पर्णः
N. of Viṣṇu.
--प्रतानः the tendril
of a creeper;

.
--भवनं an
arbour, a bower.
--मणिः coral.
--मंडपः a bower, an arbour.
--मृगः a
monkey.
--यष्टिः f. Bengal madder.
--यावकं a shoot, sprout.
--वलयः, --यं
an arbour.
--वृक्षः the cocoa-nut tree.
--वेष्टः a kind of coitus or mode of
sexual enjoyment.
--वेष्टनं, --वेष्टितकं
a kind of embrace.

1 A small creeper.
--2 A
string of pearls.
